purpose: Test whether observable-channel poison auditability and strong feature baselines transfer from MNIST/BloodMNIST to a histopathology domain with an external-center test split.

dataset.name: PathMNIST 28x28

training_subset.selection: exactly 3,000 rows per class selected without replacement from the official training split, then restored to official-index order
training_subset.reason: bounded CPU pilot; this is not a full-training PathMNIST benchmark

dataset.test: full official CRC-VAL-HE-7K test split from a different clinical center

attack.selection: uniform without replacement from non-target rows in the frozen 27,000-row training subset
attack.construction: replace selected training images in place, overwrite labels with target 8, retain official source indices

victim.architecture: Conv3x3(3,16)-BN-ReLU; residual blocks 16, 32/stride2, 64/stride2; global average pool; Linear(64,9)
victim.paired_training: clean and suspect roles use identical initialization, shuffled-index order, and augmentation RNG for a seed
victim.augmentation: independent per-sample horizontal and vertical flips with probability 0.5, seeded by 20270930 + seed
victim.checkpoint_policy: save clean and suspect best-epoch state dictionaries, preprocessing, seed, role, training history, protocol hash and SHA-256

victim_evaluation.clean_metric: balanced accuracy on the untouched external-center official test split
victim_evaluation.attack_metric: target-class ASR on patched official non-target test images

detector_pool.trusted_reference: full clean official validation split with true labels
detector_pool.candidates: full frozen 27,000-row in-place poisoned training subset with assigned labels
detector_pool.drift_scope: oracle paired-clean diagnostic, not a deployable default

cf_cmd_u.trusted_target_split: 512 whitening-reference and 512 disjoint calibration rows selected from validation target class
cf_cmd_u.whitening: reference covariance with ridge equal to 0.1 times mean marginal variance
cf_cmd_u.sample_exclusion: two candidate halves; score each half with the opposite-half mean direction
cf_cmd_u.calibration_claim: clean-validation rank calibration only; exact exchangeability for training-member queries is not claimed

development.expansion_gate: both victims eligible; all nine classes present; all defined method scores finite; compressed sample artifacts replay exactly; both seeds remain within the runtime cap

confirmation.start_condition: development expansion gate passes without code, data, architecture, attack, threshold or method changes
confirmation.ten_seed_expansion: not automatic; consider only if at least four of five confirmation victims are eligible and a seed-level interval remains decision-relevant

interpretation.positive_scope: external-domain evidence for a fixed attack, bounded training subset and lightweight residual victim
interpretation.negative_result_policy: retain victim, calibration, detector or runtime failure without retuning on development outcomes
forbidden_claims: full-training PathMNIST state of the art
paired drift is deployable without a clean oracle
rank p-values are exact conformal p-values for training-member candidates
one fixed BadNets result proves cross-attack robustness
